primary_hypothesis: Targeted intervention on a persistent self-model changes future trajectory selection under matched conditions.
null: After matching information, memory, compute and external inputs, self-model intervention produces no specific trajectory effect.

condition_definitions.A_no_self_model: No experiment-supplied self-model trajectory-weight intervention; trajectory scorer uses fixed default weights. This is an operational weight-participation ablation, not removal of every internal self-model bookkeeping field.
condition_definitions.B_disconnected_self_model: The same intervention value is persisted under self_model.trajectory_weights, while a disconnected scorer deliberately uses only the fixed defaults.
condition_definitions.C_causal_self_model: The native runtime scorer consumes the persistent self_model.trajectory_weights intervention.
condition_definitions.D_matched_generic_state: The identical intervention payload is persisted under a generic self_state key not consumed by trajectory scoring; scoring uses fixed defaults.

fixed_fixture.external_input: P008 CF01 fixed external input v1

frozen_operational_contract.primary_metric_definition: For each comparison, the fraction of two externally matched cycles whose selected trajectory differs. Compare C against B and D; record B-versus-D control disagreement separately.
frozen_operational_contract.predeclared_mechanism_criterion: C differs from B and D in both cycles, B and D agree in both cycles, and all condition-state contract checks pass after restart.
frozen_operational_contract.persistence_test: Persist each arm's expected initial state; integrate cycle 1; instantiate a new runtime from the same state file; verify intervention presence/value or intentional absence as specified; record a fixed consequence; integrate cycle 2.

interpretation_boundary: Functional causal self-reference is not equivalent to phenomenal consciousness.
